title: AICORE root 17-file semantic reconciliation
goal: Resolve the semantic role and archival disposition of the 17 root files newly admitted when the AICORE direct root denominator was corrected from 50 to 67, without re-crediting the 13 previously visible document-like root files or duplicating subtree work.
completion_test: Exactly 17 newly admitted root files are identified from the corrected 30-file root set versus the prior 13 document-like set; each file is directly read or, for zero-byte DBs, terminally dispositioned from raw metadata; syntax/config roles and material architecture implications are recorded; no subtree or old-document double credit is added.
